headline: Lamball Fluffy Shield
title: Lamball | Your First Shield Pal | Palworld Guide
video_script: Is Lamball useless? Not quite. Its partner skill, Fluffy Shield, turns it into a shield you carry. It also sometimes drops Wool when you put it on a Ranch. At base, Lamball works Handiwork, Transporting and Farming, all at level one. It is the very first Pal in the Paldeck, so you will meet it early. Do you keep a Lamball on your ranch? Comment below!
description: Lamball in Palworld 1.0: Fluffy Shield partner skill, Wool at the Ranch, and Handiwork, Transporting and Farming level one.
